A perspective shaped by experience

Chun-Hao Li is a professor in the Department of Social and Policy Sciences and Dean of Yuan Ze University’s College of Humanities and Social Sciences. He is listed among the faculty associated with IBSC.

His expertise covers population research, including historical population studies, and urban studies. He earned graduate degrees in Sociology and Urban Affairs at Michigan State University.

His research includes family and migration in Taiwan, historical household records, and the experiences and well-being of immigrants. He is also affiliated with Academia Sinica’s Institute of Ethnology as an adjunct research fellow.

Teaching & research interests

  • Population studies
  • Historical demography
  • Urban studies

Education

  • Ph.D. in Sociology and Urban Affairs — Michigan State University
  • M.A. in Sociology and Urban Affairs — Michigan State University
